parameters: Today, a new student will be transferred to our class
今天有一位新同学要转进我们班
First, let's introduce ourselves to you
先给大家自我介绍一下吧
Hello, everyone. My name is Freelyn
Hello, everyone. My name is Freelyn
It seems that there is nothing to say
好像没有什么可说的了
Oh, by the way, I'm the head of SOS Supernatural Research Club
哦对了，我是SOS超自然研究部的部长
If you are interested, please join us
大家有兴趣的话，欢迎加入我们
Our class is busy too. Don't try to trick our classmates to work for you
学园祭我们班也很忙的，可别想着骗我们班同学去给你干活
Go to the empty seat first and sit down
Didn't you wake up just now? Why did you go back to sleep
刚才不是已经醒了吗，怎么又睡回去了
So sleepy in the early morning
Did you stay up late for Abex!
You may not obey though I talk to you
虽然说了你可能也不会听
Don't stay up late to play Abex!
As I told everyone, our Kakuensai will begin tomorrow
就同之前和大家说的一样，学园祭明天就要开始了
请那两位同学不要窃窃私语
王缪可，汐！说的就是你们两个！
It's all your fault! We just been scolded!
The next class will be a self-study session. For those who have duties for either the stage play rehearsal or the booth preparation, please go to your places and standby
下面这节课是自习课，报了名要演舞台剧和想去摊位帮忙的同学现在可以过去了
One more thing, although I have asked this before, any volunteers for the blackboard newspaper?
还有一件事就是，真的没有人想画黑板报吗？
Although the blackboard newspaper isn't particularly important, it still counts as an opportunity to showcase oneself
虽然黑板报确实不是特别重要的，不过也算是一次展示自己的机会
没有同学要报名参加吗？
Ari sang didn't you just join the stage play
雅莉同学你不是要演舞台剧吗？
Not too much time to draw blackboard newspaper for you
给你画黑板报的时间不多了
那好吧，雅莉你就去试试吧
But you can't slack off on the stage play either
但是舞台剧那边也不能偷懒哦
Who's that sitting next to me
I wonder why I don't know about this guy
为什么我好像没见过她
Have you not even remembered your classmate sitting next door for so long?
那么久了你连坐隔壁的同学都没记住吗？
Why does she hang a dried fish on her ear
她为什么要在耳朵上挂条小鱼干呀
So that I can always have dried fish to eat when I'm hungry?
为了饿的时候随时有小鱼干可以吃？
Can I also ask you for dried fish to eat when I'm hungry?
那我饿了的时候也能找你要小鱼干吃吗？
Sure, I'll give you salmon flavor
可以哦，到时候给你三文鱼口味的
Perhaps she never woke up at all?
Can she continue the conversation even if she's asleep?
睡着了也能继续对话吗？
Can this also be considered a supernatural phenomenon?
这或许也能算作一种超自然现象？
I feel like I can study it
Oh, right. Freelyn is the head of the Supernatural Department
对哦，菲林同学是超自然部的部长
Speaking of which, what exactly does your club do
说起来你们这个社团到底是做什么的
After all, there shouldn't be any supernatural phenomena in this world, right
毕竟，这世界上应该不存在超自然现象吧
At first, I just thought it was fun and submitted a randomly written application result. I don't know why it was finally approved
当初只是觉得好玩就交了份随便乱写的申请结果不知道为什么最后通过了
Maybe this is also a supernatural phenomenon
或许这也是一种超自然现象吧
Huh? You are... Ah, you are Freelyn sang
I'm sorry I fell asleep just now
It doesn't matter. Now that we wake up, we can start club activities
没关系，现在睡醒了我们就可以开始社团活动咯
Freelyn is the head of the SOS club
菲林是超自然研究部的部长哦
